instruction: Display all men's extra-large short-sleeve shirts with a discount of 40% or more.

metadata.explanation: Variation 1: Changed size from L to XL, discount from 50% to 40%, keeps short-sleeve. Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Getter logic mismatch - get_macys_product_url_parse at chrome.py:2551-2554 only checks for '50_PERCENT_ off & more', but instruction requires '40% or more' discount
Expected value will never match getter output - getter returns either '50_PERCENT_ off & more' or 'not_50_PERCENT_ off & more', but expected is '40_PERCENT_ off & more'
Hardcoded discount logic in getter does not support the required 40% discount threshold - only supports 50%, 30%, and 20% checks
Evaluator will always fail at runtime because the getter cannot extract the correct discount value for 40%+ requirement
All other requirements (mens_clothing, shirts, size XL, short_sleeve) are correctly verified
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update get_macys_product_url_parse logic at chrome.py:2551-2554 to support 40% discount checking
Modify the discount extraction logic to handle all discount ranges (20%, 30%, 40%, 50%) instead of hardcoding only 50%
Change getter to return the actual discount value from URL instead of hardcoded string literals
Alternative: Update expected value to '50_PERCENT_ off & more' to match what the getter can actually return (but this changes the instruction requirement)
